entities.summary: Vladimir Bill-Belotserkovsky (b. 1885-01-09, Oleksandriia) was a journalist or media commentator of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Oleksandriia. Known in the fields of poets & playwrights.
